**Role Overview**

eNGINE is seeking a Software Engineer with strong C# and .NET development experience to build, enhance, and maintain business-critical applications. This role is primarily focused on backend development, including application logic, integrations, APIs, and database-driven functionality.

The ideal candidate brings a hands-on engineering mindset and can contribute to technical discussions around solution design, architecture, and implementation approaches. We’re looking for someone who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, collaborating with other developers, and translating design concepts into reliable, maintainable code. Experience with e-commerce applications or online marketplaces would be a plus.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain application functionality using C# and .NET, with an emphasis on backend services and business logic.
* Contribute to solution design discussions, helping evaluate technical approaches, application architecture, and implementation trade-offs.
* Build and maintain APIs, service integrations, and data-driven application components.
* Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code that supports application performance, scalability, and long-term reliability.
* Work with relational databases to develop queries, support data access patterns, and troubleshoot performance issues.
* Collaborate with technical team members and business stakeholders to translate requirements into practical software solutions.
* Identify opportunities to improve existing applications through refactoring, debugging, and targeted enhancements.
* Participate in code reviews, testing, and troubleshooting to maintain development quality and consistency.
* Take features from initial design through hands-on development, testing, and delivery.
